_comment: Every generated asset Hollowmere can use. The game loads Resources/Models/<key> and Resources/Audio/<key>; anything missing falls back to a coloured primitive or silence, so this list can be filled in gradually. Run tools/fetch_assets.py to generate whatever is missing. priority 1 = generate first.
style: stylized low-poly fantasy game asset, hand-painted textures, mobile game, clean silhouette, single object, no base, no background
